events.verdict: Bane (MEM) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Vucevic (CHI) and any ensuing contact is incidental.
Bane (MEM) intentionally kicks the ball in an attempt to gain possession.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Dosunmu (CHI) on the perimeter.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) briefly places a hand to White's (CHI) front as he drives to the basket but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Aldama (MEM) hops consecutively on the same foot as he spins upon gathering the ball.
Bane (MEM) places his off-arm against Dosunmu's (CHI) body and releases from the contact.
Bane (MEM) splits his feet at the start of his dribble.

Dosunmu (CHI) has a hand placed on Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) hip as he elevates for the putback shot attempt. Jackson Jr. is jumping in the opposite direction and there is no illegal extension from Dosunmu.
LaVine (CHI) places his extended arm against Smart's (MEM) back as Smart reaches for the rebound that bounces out of reach.
Vucevic (CHI) briefly grasps Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) left arm as he attempts to establish post position but the contact does not dislodge Pippen Jr. from his position.

Replay review of the foul called on Pippen Jr. (MEM) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Pippen Jr. walks underneath Vucevic (CHI) and grabs his shorts, affecting his ability to pursue the rebound.
Smart (MEM) commits a take foul on Giddey (OKC).
LaRavia (MEM) commits a take foul on Giddey (OKC).
Williams (CHI) legally contests Bane's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Dosunmu (CHI) grabs and pulls Aldama's (MEM) jersey away from his body as he attempts to save the ball from going out of bounds.
